plain_description: Alibaba Cloud's Qwen3 family delivers enterprise-grade AI reasoning, coding, and agent capabilities — all in one open-source model family. It handles complex problem-solving with thinking mode and fast everyday chat without, supporting 100+ languages and tool use out of the box. The bottom line: deploy state-of-the-art LLM performance on your own infrastructure or in the cloud, with models ranging from 0.6B to 235B parameters.
technical_description: Qwen3 is a family of large language models from Alibaba Cloud's Qwen team offering dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures (0.6B to 235B-A22B parameters). It provides dual-mode inference with thinking (step-by-step reasoning) and non-thinking (fast chat) modes selectable at inference time via chat template parameters. Context windows span 256K tokens, extendable to 1M tokens for long-document understanding. The models are served through Hugging Face Transformers, vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, and MLX LM, each exposing OpenAI-compatible REST API endpoints. Deployment targets include NVIDIA GPUs, Apple Silicon, Intel CPUs via OpenVINO, Ascend NPUs via MindIE, and mobile/edge devices via ExecuTorch and MNN. Post-training is supported via Axolotl, UnSloth, LLaMA-Factory, and Swift for SFT, DPO, and GRPO. Tool use and function calling with MCP integration are available through Qwen-Agent.
title: Qwen3
